verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a live llms.txt at docs.ramp.com, confirmed by a probe returning HTTP 200. Its docs surface tells agents explicitly to fetch the /llms-guides/<slug>.txt plain-text files instead of the JS-rendered HTML pages. It also ships plain-text API reference and combined exports, a canonical OpenAPI spec (probe-verified, 174 paths), and an unauthenticated Developer MCP server that gives agents live access to the docs.
